hero.title: Power Optimized
hero.description: Designing high-efficiency power distribution grids, custom PCB hardware architectures, and digital control systems for industrial and renewable energy networks.

capabilities.title: Power Electronics & Conversion
capabilities.description: Designing high-efficiency switching topologies, buck-boost converters, and inverter circuits with optimized thermal management and low EMI.

capabilities.title: Embedded Systems & Firmware
capabilities.description: Developing low-level microcontroller firmware for real-time sensor data acquisition, hardware-level interrupts, and communication protocols (I2C, SPI, CAN bus).

capabilities.title: Smart Grid & Automation
capabilities.description: Implementing decentralized telemetry networks, protective relay coordination, and automated fault detection, isolation, and service restoration (FDIR).

projects.title: HTV Silicone Rubber Insulator Simulation
projects.description: This research project focuses on simulating electric field distribution in HTV silicone rubber polymer insulators under varying contamination and voltage conditions.
